# Public Voices For Public Schools

> A public education advocacy organization dedicated to defending public schools and exposing the failures of charter school expansion and school voucher programs.

Public Voices For Public Schools amplifies community voices and expert analysis on education policy, focusing on the harms of privatization initiatives and advocating for equitable, well-funded public education systems. The organization features contributions from educators, researchers, and community organizers working to counter charter school expansion and voucher schemes.

## Key Topics

- Public education advocacy
- Charter schools criticism
- School vouchers
- Education policy
- Anti-privatization
- Public school defense
- Community organizing
- Racial discrimination in schools
- School reform
- Education equity
- Voucher schools
- Public education advocates
- Community perspectives
- Education commentary
- School accountability

## Organization & Mission

- [About Us](https://pv4ps.org/about-us): Organization mission and background on public education advocacy
- [Our Voices](https://pv4ps.org/our-voices): Featured contributors including educators, researchers, and community organizers advocating for public education

## Charter School Analysis

- [The Billion-Dollar Experiment: How New Orleans' Charter School Revolution Failed](https://pv4ps.org/the-billion-dollar-experiment-how-new-orleans-charter-school-revolution-failed-the-children-it-promised-to-save): Investigation of New Orleans charter school inequality and systemic failures post-Hurricane Katrina
- [A Tie at the Top: Supreme Court Split on Religious Charter Schools](https://pv4ps.org/a-tie-at-the-top-why-the-supreme-courts-4-4-split-on-religious-charter-schools-still-spells-trouble-for-public-education): Analysis of Supreme Court case on religious institutions operating charter schools and implications for public education

## School Vouchers & Privatization

- [Maine "Town Academy" Voucher School Refused to Address Racial Intimidation](https://pv4ps.org/maine-town-academy-voucher-school-refused-to-address-racial-intimidation): Analysis of Maine Town Academies' failure to address racial discrimination and accountability issues in voucher schools
